name: verify_pdf_extraction
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,hashlib
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','inputs/sources/path.pdf','-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
s=Path('inputs/texts/path.txt').read_text(); print('Actual PDF extraction matches supplied text:',r.stdout==s,'pdf_sha256',hashlib.sha256(Path('inputs/sources/path.pdf').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('SYNCHRONY pp2-4')
p=Path('texts/synchrony.txt').read_text().split('\f')
for k in [2,3,4,7,12]: print('PAGE',k,p[k-1])
